responsibility: Declares the immutable, singleton-style façade over Resolver2_0 name-resolution results. It provides the interface for freezing a finished NameResolutionContext and later retrieving a const reference to it, giving downstream Rust frontend stages a stable read-only view of the multi-namespace resolver state built by the new name-resolution passes.
same_name_distinction: Declares the read-only singleton wrapper API used to expose a finished NameResolutionContext to later phases; the paired .cc file implements the static instance storage, initialization, and accessor functions.
